journal: J. Phys. Chem. 85(20), 2886-2895 (Rogers and Pitzer; PDF page 1 begins with another article's end)
experimental_method: Flow calorimeter (differential, reference vs working side) measuring heat capacity of aqueous Na2SO4 from 30 to 200 C at 1 bar/saturation pressure and at 200 bar; solutions made by weight.
uncertainties_stated: Maximum precision of a specific heat capacity measurement roughly +-0.002 J g-1 K-1; ratio uncertainty +-0.0005 (1.7% in (ps*pw... ) ratio); pressure monitored to +-1 bar; temperature stable to 0.01 K.
quality_remarks: Authors caution the few data points above 1.5 m (supersaturated at room temperature, saturation 1.56 m at 22 C) should be used with caution. Densities at 25 C used in analysis are from literature or estimated from compressibilities (200 bar, >0.33 m). The 474.68 K block is printed with only 4 rows (to 0.2491 m); the block looks truncated in the print.
not_extracted_tables: Table II (Pitzer equations), Table III (fit parameters), Table IV (mean activity coefficients, calculated) are model/derived; Tables V-VII are supplementary material not in the PDF.

row_counts.table_1: printed 71 data rows in 8 T/P blocks; written 71 data rows plus 8 label rows

extraction_notes: Text layer matched the page image in all cells. phiCp is derived by authors from the ratio; ratio is value2. Pressure printed differs between the ratio column and the other columns (see pressure_note). Temperature scale not stated.
needs_pass2_reason: text layer clean and every cell matched the image
pass2_diff: Table I: every pass-1 number occurs in pass 2; the pass-2-only numbers are the printed pressure sub-header strings; the 474.68 K block prints 4 rows only in both passes.
